verdict.rationale: The official Together TypeScript SDK README says it supports streaming responses using Server-Sent Events (SSE), which is the core of this story. The OpenAI-compatible API (swap the key and base URL) suggests standard streaming clients work too, but no cited item says so explicitly. Missing for 10: first-party API docs describing token-by-token streaming (the stream parameter and chunk format), explicit confirmation that streaming works through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency and responsiveness.
